key_claims.claim: An AI fracture detection tool maintained diagnostic accuracy across three European hospitals and improved clinician sensitivity and specificity when used as a second reader
Errors in a prior deep-learning CTG study for predicting neonatal acidemia have been formally corrected; primary findings remain but specific figures required amendment
Deep-learning image quality scores calibrated to actual prostate cancer detection accuracy outperform subjective reader-based quality labels in predicting AI diagnostic performance
68Ga-NK224 PET/CT noninvasively captures whole-body PD-L1 heterogeneity in NSCLC, and lesion-specific uptake correlates with immunotherapy response better than single-biopsy IHC
Pre-treatment oxygen extraction fraction derived from DSC-MRI predicts which ischemic core voxels will undergo diffusion reversal after successful reperfusion
